title: Pan-cancer C1–C4 lactate-associated state atlas: analysis code
description: Analysis code supporting the C1–C4 atlas of lactate-associated transcription and inflammatory remodelling across human cancers. The release starts from matching prepared inputs and includes state definitions, clinical and molecular comparisons, drug-response associations, single-cell and ICB analyses, and CD8 perturbation analyses. Research data and original sequencing preprocessing are not included.
